instructions.text: 200g Low Fat Greek/PIain Yoghurt 2g Powdered Sweetener* Igppjng; 1/2 Tsp Cocoa Powder
Add the oats, protein powder, instant coffee (or espresso), almond milk, vanilla essence, salt, and sweetener to a small pot.

Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the oats is soft and creamy. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. (Alternatively, microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until thick and creamy,)
1n a separate bowl, mix the yoghurt and sweetener until well combined.
Layer half the oats into a serving glass or bowl, followed by a layer of sweetened yoghurt. Repeat with the remaining oats and yoghurt.
Sprinkle with cocoa powder and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. Enjoy!
